item.title: OMP Usage 1.0.0
item.description:
# OMP Usage 1.0.0
- Distributed as a single DMG containing `OMP Usage.app` and a short `Install.txt`. - First launch opens a native setup window. It detects an existing Node.js 22.18+ and omp (including nvm), lets you edit or browse for their absolute paths, edit the omp profile (an existing default config is detected automatically), and installs on **Install & Open**. Clicking Install also registers a per-user login LaunchAgent. - The app copies itself without admin rights to `~/Applications/OMP Usage.app`, preserving quarantine and extended attributes, and relaunches from there. There is no `/Applications` link. - Node.js and omp are not bundled or installed; Setup does not read, copy or change omp credentials or plugins. An existing valid configuration is kept byte-identical; an invalid one is reported, not reset. - Existing users update through the in-app updater using the same feed, key and bundle identity; settings and preferences are preserved. - Not Developer ID signed or notarized (ad-hoc/Ed25519 signed). Gatekeeper may block the first downloaded copy before the app runs.

item.title: OMP Usage 1.0.1
item.description:
## Fixes
- Removed providers no longer leave placeholder rings in the compact panel. Open provider details are reconciled when a successful usage result no longer reports the provider. - Keep saved provider selection and left/right placement for reconnection. Failed refreshes and older cached results no longer resurrect a confirmed removal. - Removal follows normal collection/cache timing; use Refresh to bypass the cache immediately. omp credentials and provider plugins are never modified.
## Release automation
- Build and test universal macOS DMGs on GitHub-hosted runners with verifiable build-provenance attestations. - Authenticate the exact CI-built bytes before local update signing; the signing key stays in the maintainer's Keychain. - Add scheduled public-release integrity checks and fix the CI packaging CLI's module-import cycle.
## Install or update
Existing users: choose Check for Updates and install 1.0.1. Configuration, display preferences and update choices are preserved.
New users: open the DMG, launch OMP Usage.app and choose Install & Open. Requires macOS 13+, Node.js 22.18+ and an authenticated omp with JSON usage support. The app is ad-hoc code-signed and not Apple-notarized.
